text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Today is Valentine's Day, and the<n>students have
been excitedly<n>exchanging gifts since morning.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Howdy! Happy Valentine's Day,<n>Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
And ya can't have Valentine's Day<n>without
chocolate!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
So I bought a chocolate cake to thank<n>ya for all your
hard work!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Honest, I really did buy it. But...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
The thing is... that cake kinda<n>accidentally ended up
in my stomach!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
But it was downright delectable! I<n>really want ya to
try it too!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
So let's go buy another one together!<n>I might eat
the whole thing again if I<n>go by myself!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
At Taiki Shuttle's urging, we go into<n>town to buy a
cake together.<n>However...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Nooo! Whaddya mean they're all sold<n>out?!

text_block_list.name: Shop Staff A
text_block_list.text: I'm terribly sorry. That cake was very<n>popular...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
What're we gonna do now? That<n>was supposed to
be your present...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Unable to buy a replacement cake,<n>Taiki grows
disheartened.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I can see by her expression just how<n>much she
wants to make me happy.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry... I'm the only one who got<n>to eat the
cake...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
But I know the rules—ya gotta give<n>chocolate here in
Japan!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Just the thought ain't enough!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Okay—let's look for a different gift!<n>You're definitely
gettin' some kinda<n>thank-you chocolate today!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Ah, how 'bout this one? You eat it<n>with rice, just
like curry!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Or what about this one? You mix it<n>with rice to make
chocolate fried rice!<n>Looks fun!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I spend the rest of Valentine's Day<n>with a Taiki
Shuttle determined to<n>show her gratitude.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: No! That ain't enough to put my mind<n>at ease!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I got it! I'll make ya the chocolate<n>cake myself! I still
remember how it<n>tasted!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I can see you're worried, but<n>everything'll be just
hunky-dory! I'm<n>a barbeque master, after all!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I head back to the academy,<n>wondering what
barbecues have to<n>do with baking cakes.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: After a brief wait in my office...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Sorry for the holdup! Here's your<n>chocolate cake!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Sure, it came out a little black, but it's<n>shaped just
like the cake from<n>before. And I'm confident about
the<n>taste!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Ya know, I'm kinda glad they were<n>sold out.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: You're always workin' so hard to<n>help me.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
It's only fair I work hard too to show<n>my
appreciation! Tit for tat!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Aww, you're welcome! Now, go<n>ahead and dig in!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Taiki Shuttle's thank-you gift ends up<n>having a little
bitterness to it.
